## PureChain v1.0.1

A maintenance release on top of v1.0.0: security and safety fixes backported
from go-ethereum v1.17.5 → v1.17.8, the PoA² validator-replacement controller,
and the client now names itself PureChain. No consensus rules change; v1.0.0
and v1.0.1 nodes interoperate, and the upgrade is a plain binary swap.

### Download

| File | Platform |
|---|---|
| `purechain-geth-v1.0.1-linux-amd64` | Linux x86-64 |
| `purechain-geth-v1.0.1-linux-arm64` | Linux ARM64 (incl. AWS Graviton) |

Statically linked (`CGO_ENABLED=0`), so they run on Alpine and glibc images
alike with no libc dependency.

```bash
chmod +x purechain-geth-v1.0.1-linux-amd64
./purechain-geth-v1.0.1-linux-amd64 version
```

### What's in this release

**The client advertises itself as PureChain.** `web3_clientVersion`, the p2p
handshake name, `admin.nodeInfo` and ethstats now read
`PureChain/v1.13.15-purechain-1.0.1-<commit>-<date>/…` instead of
`Geth/v1.13.15-stable-<commit>/…`, and `geth version` prints
`1.13.15-purechain-1.0.1`. Only the displayed name changed: the datadir layout,
nodekey, `geth.ipc` and the `geth` command are untouched, so nodes restart onto
their existing data with the same enode IDs. If you have tooling that matches
on the string `Geth`, update it.

**A validator no longer seals a block built on a failed database read.** If
storage fails a read while a block is being built, its state may be wrong; the
miner now refuses to seal it instead of broadcasting it (upstream #35427). On
v1.13.15 this check alone is not enough — Clique seals a copy of the work
state and `StateDB.Copy()` dropped the error — so `Copy()` now keeps it, as
upstream has since #29520.

**Security.** `GetPooledTransactions` is capped at 4096 lookups per request
(#35857); snap trie-node requests served from cache now count against the
per-request work budget (#35856); discovery only accepts endpoint statements
from bonded peers (#35861).

**Txpool journal.** A failed write of the replacement journal (e.g. disk full)
no longer replaces a good journal with a truncated one (#35564).

**PoA² validator replacement.** `rehearsal/scripts/poa2.js` is an RPC-only
sidecar that replaces a validator that stops sealing with a pre-vetted standby,
hardened against six failure modes found while rehearsing it. See the
[PoA² guide](https://gieworld.github.io/purechain-docs/03-operating/poa2/).

**Testing.** The upgrade rehearsal passed 110/110 gates twice, once with every
node pinned to two shared CPUs (`rehearsal/docker-compose.2cpu.yml`, new). The
full adoption matrix for the backports, including what was rejected and why,
is in [`docs/upstream-backports.md`](docs/upstream-backports.md).

### Upgrading from v1.0.0

Swap the binary and restart, one node at a time — RPC nodes first, then
validators. No genesis, config or on-disk format change, and downgrading to
v1.0.0 works the same way.
